responsibility: Implements C++ front-end UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer instrumentation for vptr-related checks. It decides when vptr sanitization is applicable, inserts IFN_UBSAN_VPTR checks for virtual/member calls, member accesses, downcasts, and casts to virtual bases, and initializes base-class vtable pointers to null during construction when needed so invalid virtual dispatches are caught before full object initialization completes.
